long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Penne, Italy, Andrea Agostinone studied economics at Bocconi University and began his career in Malta in international tax planning. He later moved into corporate finance, becoming a partner in London-based advisory ventures and serving in investment-management roles. Those assignments gave him a base for projects spanning several European jurisdictions.

Agostinone subsequently developed property and investment interests in the Baltics and the Gulf. He became a sizeable shareholder in Inbank, the Estonian digital lender founded by Jan Andresoo and Priit Põldoja. He also retained ownership of an Estonian real-estate company and continued leading Mesen Associated in Dubai. His Inbank role has remained that of a substantial minority investor rather than an operating bank founder.
